claim_boundary: A pass can establish only narrow same-provider new-family confirmation that the frozen tiled target-only FFA pipeline acquires and localizes one bound physical door from full query frames. Same-provider geometry selected reference boxes. It cannot establish calibrated open-set absence, broad distractor coverage, raw-phone or provider-independent generalization, named entrance ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety.

tiling.merge: Retain up to 16 full-frame and 8 per tile, remap to full-image coordinates, then rank their SAM-masked FFA descriptors together without NMS or truth filtering.
